title: Gemini 4 Neon: Speed, Accuracy and Cost Tested
summary: Gemini 4 Neon processes end-to-end tasks faster for automation workflows. It enables quicker chaining of multiple operations in tools like Activepieces.
body_markdown:
## What to watch as Neon launches


Watch for any change to Neon's price or documented behavior, because either one moves the premium you just weighed against accuracy. Then rerun one real workflow on your own data.


> **Neon only earns that premium if it's meaningfully more accurate on the tasks where mistakes cost you.


On 2026-11-18 Google released Gemini 4 Neon and positioned it within the Gemini 4 family. Beyond that, we have only the maker's own description, so treat claims about speed or accuracy as Google's, not ours.


Next month, a cost comparison you run today may not hold, because launch-week pricing and limits are the likeliest things to shift.


### Gemini 4 Neon sources and when checked


Three pages are worth a standing slot in your Monday checklist, and each tells you something different.


Check Google's announcement page for edits to the capability claims or new caveats added after launch, which would change what you can assume. Check Google's pricing page for any change to the per-token rates or tier names, since that changes your cost per run.


Check the docs changelog for new model versions, deprecation notices or behavior changes, any of which could break a prompt you already tuned.


This week, pick one workflow where a wrong answer costs you. Run it through Neon and your current model on the same inputs, and have the person who owns it grade the outputs.
